title: sister_deleted_my_parkour_run
beats: My sister deleted 3 hours of my parkour footage — because I beat her boyfriend's world record on camera (26F).
I've been running this Minecraft parkour map for a TikTok series, 40k followers, brand deal on the line.
Her boyfriend Chris (29M) streams the same map, calls himself the fastest runner in our friend group.
Last week I clipped his record by four seconds, clean run, fully recorded, ready to post.
My sister grabbed my laptop 'to charge it' and the footage folder came back empty.
I checked the recycle bin, checked cloud backup, gone — she admitted she did it so Chris 'wouldn't feel bad'.
I told her that was my income, not a trophy for her boyfriend's ego.
Now she's saying I'm heartless for 'humiliating family' and my parents are telling me to just re-record it and move on.
I re-ran the map, beat the record again, and posted both times with the deletion story attached.
It's already got triple the views the original clip would have gotten.
